name: kotlin-android
description: detekt with type resolution, ktlint, strict Android Lint, and Kotlin warnings as errors, each with a native baseline.

tools.name: detekt
tools.why: Kotlin static analysis; the Gradle plugin gives it type resolution

merge.into: each module's build.gradle.kts (or a convention plugin in build-logic)
merge.how: Apply the detekt plugin and settings, turn Kotlin warnings into errors, and point Android Lint at lint.xml with a baseline. A convention plugin applied to every module keeps modules from opting out.

baseline: Run ./gradlew detektBaseline to write detekt-baseline.xml, run ./gradlew lint once so Android Lint writes lint-baseline.xml, and run ktlint --baseline=ktlint-baseline.xml. Commit all three; new code must pass without additions to them.
